# PumpPilot AI

> Explainable AI for crypto momentum: a market scanner, paper trading, AI coaching, backtesting and strict risk controls. Paper trading is the default and live execution stays locked. All market data shown in the product is mock/demo data. Predictions are probabilistic, returns are not guaranteed, and users can lose all capital.

PumpPilot AI never requests or stores seed phrases or private keys. Wallet connection is read-only and includes phishing/drainer scanning.

## Pages

- [Home](/): What PumpPilot AI is, how explainable momentum scores work, and how to start free.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Pay-as-you-go credits — no subscription. Credits are spent per prediction, backtest or AI audit.
- [Scanner](/scanner): Momentum scanner with plain-English reasons for every score.
- [Paper trading](/paper): Risk-free paper portfolio; live execution is disabled by design.
- [Backtesting](/backtest): Rehearse strategies against historical demo data.
- [Strategy builder](/strategy): Build and share rule-based momentum strategies.
- [Risk controls](/risk): Position sizing, exposure caps and locked live-trading switch.
- [Security Center](/security): Phishing detection, wallet approval scans and exportable audit logs.
- [Learn](/learn): Guides on momentum, risk and disciplined investing.
- [Community](/community): Public strategies you can review and fork.
- [Developers](/developers): Public API, embeddable momentum widget and MCP agent integration.
- [Blog](/blog): Guides and comparisons on AI investing.
